title: Real-Time Face Detection in Python

steps.title: Step 1: Setup
steps.explanation: We start by importing OpenCV and loading the pre-trained face detection model.

steps.title: Step 2: Capture Video
steps.explanation: Next, we initialize the video capture to use the default webcam.

steps.title: Step 3: Detect Faces
steps.explanation: We convert the frame to grayscale and detect faces using the cascade classifier.

steps.title: Step 4: Draw Rectangles
steps.explanation: For each detected face, we draw a rectangle around it in real-time.

steps.title: Step 5: Display & Exit
steps.explanation: Finally, we display the output and allow the user to exit by pressing 'q'.

intro_hook: Detect faces in real-time with just a few lines of code!
